temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn for several days during a busy week at the bank. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is normally engaging, so her recent quietness is uncharacteristic and may mean something is wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Marilyn's quietness is likely due to being overwhelmed by work and personal issues, and she is willing to acknowledge that.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn is struggling with work and personal stress, but is not necessarily ready to share details.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, sympathetic, and slightly reassured that Marilyn responded.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and keep communication open without pressuring Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn was curt in a later interaction, leaving Carolyn confused and hurt. When Carolyn shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn is uncertain whether she overstepped or whether Marilyn is upset with her because of Marilyn's curtness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Marilyn's curtness was not personal; it was due to a hard week, and Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's openness and support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes the misunderstanding is clearing and that Marilyn values her support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved and encouraged, with earlier confusion and hurt beginning to ease.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clarify any misunderstanding, show support, and continue being open with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness, and Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful about their budding friendship. Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small weekend gathering, and Marilyn thanks her and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is warming toward her and that their friendship is beginning to develop.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Marilyn accepts the social invitation enthusiastically, suggesting she wants to strengthen the friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes the friendship is mutual and growing, and that Marilyn values spending time with her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To host the gathering and build a closer friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives that Marilyn still maintains a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk about improving their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is keeping a professional distance at work even though their personal interactions have been friendly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Marilyn was unaware of the perceived distance and is willing to discuss and improve their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes the workplace distance may not be intentional and can be addressed through direct conversation.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed before the conversation, then cautiously hopeful and relieved after Marilyn's response.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To talk through their work dynamic and improve collaboration with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn feels they have cleared the air and better understand professional expectations and personal boundaries. Carolyn proposes teaming up on the new project proposal, and Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they had the talk, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have resolved prior tensions and understands each other's professional and personal boundaries better.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Marilyn confirms enthusiasm for working together, reinforcing that their partnership is improving.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes they have a stronger, more collaborative partnership and can work well together on the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
